minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 11, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, April 11, 2019,
at 2:04 pm in the City Council Community Room A, 1st Floor

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer
  David Salcedo, Police

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to Hold Over to reschedule the permit
  until applicant can speak to Teresa Estrada in Parks and Recreation
  regarding the date and location.  Motion carried unanimously. (Activity
  No. 00273941)

  Present: Salifu Ibrahim

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to Approve the permit requested for
  Jerrell Lowery to host Krush Grove at the Forum, April 20, 2019 from 2:00
  pm to 6:00 pm. Approved Conditionally; Additional lPD staffing maybe
  required pending the list of entertainers. Additional and adequate Forum
  security staffing required. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws.
  The applicant is responsible for crowd control and event clean up. Sound
  amplification not face residential properties. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations. Motion carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00273993)

  Present: Jerrell Lowery

Item #3:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Adriane Graham to host Dr. Graham’s Dental Wellness Center Wholeness
  Fair at 128 N. Locust Street, April 27, 2019 from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm.,
  Approved Conditionally; Applicant to hire a minimum of 2
  professional/licensed security guards for safety of attendees. NO use of
  public streets, sidewalks or alleys. All activity to be exclusively on private
 Permits & License Committee  April 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

  property .Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event clean up.
  Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No. 00274204)

  Present: Rosa Graham

Item #4:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Bob Gay, Faithful Center Bible Church to host FCBC Burnt Offerings
  Invitational at 321 Eucalyptus Street, June 15,12:00 pm to 5:00 pm., April
  27, 2019 from 10:00 am to 4:00 pm., Approved Conditionally; event within
  church parking lot. Applicant to staff this event with adequate uniformed
  security personnel (same as last year’s event) for safety of all attendees.
  NO use of public streets, sidewalks or alleys. All activity to be exclusively
  on private property. IPD W/C will be notified and extra patrols will be
  provided throughout the days of this event. Adhere to all local, state and
  federal laws. Applicant is responsible for crowd control and event clean
  up. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00274303)

Item #5  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Ericha Chancellor, to host Sweet 1 Hair Studio Unveiling at 314 E. Hillcrest
  Blvd on April 28, 2019, from 5:00 pm to 10:00 pm. Approved Conditionally;
  Approved conditionally; Applicant to have at least 2 professional, licensed
  private security guards for safety of attendees. NO use of public streets,
  sidewalks or alleys. STRICTLY PROHIBITED: alcohol possession or
  consumption and possession or use of any narcotic, including marijuana
  (cannabis activity). All activity should be exclusive to the private property
  indicated on this application. The following hair salon recommendation
  shall apply hereafter this event:
  Approved Conditionally; Applicant shall provide current ID and applicable
  state licensing on all employees. NO parties/events permitted at any time
  inside or outside of the location (day or night), No loitering in or outside the
  establishment, NO consumption of any alcoholic beverages, No narcotic
  use (including cannabis activity) at any time on the premises, NO body
  (bare skin) massages or disrobing of any kind. Adhere to all local, state and
  federal laws. Applicant is responsible to monitor crowd control and event
  clean up. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations. Motion carried
  unanimously.
  (Activity No 00274444)

Item #6  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Councilman Padilla and the City of Inglewood to host Vaccination,
  Microchips and Licensing at 1201 N. La Tijera Blvd, on April 14, 2019 from
  9:00 am to 2:00 pm. No PD staffing necessary. Extra patrol as needed by
  PD, applicant to provide responsible party contact information to PD for
  concerns regarding crowd/traffic/noise by visitors/clientele.
  Should have signage of public parking area to customers. Anyone directing
  traffic either foot traffic or vehicular traffic shall wear a reflective vest. No
  unauthorized directing traffic on public streets. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No 0024706)
 Permits & License Committee  April 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

Item #7  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Nanette Young and Ora Reed; dba: Top Line Quality Service
  Inc. Best Yet Transportation to provide shuttle services in the City of
  Inglewood., subject to payment of annual business license and tax
  renewals; Applicant shall provide valid CDL on him/herself and all
  employees (including state licenses if applicable), proof of current vehicle
  registration, CHP -or- IPD vehicle inspection (if applicable) and valid
  insurance on ALL vehicles. If providing any transportation to various
  locations, provide a current and up to date list of destinations to be serviced
  within the City of Inglewood. Applicant and all employees shall have current
  First aid / CPR certification. In the interest of public safety, this business
  shall NOT employ or have any 290 PC registrants employed at this
  establishment or any persons that may pose a threat to the safety of
  patrons or the general public. No parking of vehicles, vehicle repairs /
  maintenance of vehicles on city streets, sidewalks or alleys. Violators will
  be cited / towed at owner’s expense. ***Subject to items required by
  Finance Dept with regard to "incomplete application" *** Adhere to all local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No 00273658)

Item #8  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the business license
  request for Rachel Howell; dba: Elite Fleet Automotive to operate a car
  rental office at 3742 W. Century Blvd. #7, subject to payment of annual
  business license and tax renewals; "Approved conditionally; Applicant
  shall provide valid ID on him/herself and all employees (including state
  licenses if applicable). NO parking of vehicles, vehicle repairs /
  maintenance of vehicles on city streets, sidewalks or alleys. Per Planning
  Dept, this location is only to be utilized as office / use space only.
  Violators will be cited / towed at owner’s expense. NO vehicles to be parked
  or otherwise shown or sold from this location. Adhere to all local, state and
  federal laws." Motion carried unanimously.
  (Activity No 00274453)

Item #9  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the tobacco retailer
  license request for Manider Kaur; dba: Samy Mini Mart to operate as a
  tobacco retailer at 400 W. Manchester Blvd., subject to sales of single
  cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-
  cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons
  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have valid
  identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO
  LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage
  must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis
  products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used
  to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine,
  including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
 Permits & License Committee  April 11, 2019
Minutes  Page 4 of 4

  and/or new applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits &
  Licensing establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is
  to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties,
  social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes,
  live bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business
  owner(s) is required to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00274066)

Item #10  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the tobacco retailer
  license request for Goma Elbiali; dba: A & Z Oil LLC to operate as a
  tobacco retailer at 1244 S Inglewood Ave., subject to sales of single
  cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-

  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have valid

  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO

  must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis
  products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used
  to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine,
  including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits &
  Licensing establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is
  to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties,
  social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes,
  live bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business
  owner(s) is required to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously. (Activity No. 00274150)

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
